purpose: Exploratory aggregate-sales NeuralProphet screen; production defaults unchanged.

execution_contract.feature_recipe: Target-only daily data through each cutoff, linear trend, automatic changepoints, additive yearly and weekly seasonality, no daily seasonality, no supplied covariates. Direct multi-step autoregression uses the 91 most recent known targets. No future actuals, tuning or fallback.
execution_contract.full_screen_requires: successful native smoke with the pinned package and finite aligned outputs
execution_contract.comparison: Each standalone and fixed 75/25 naive/NeuralProphet blend against seasonal naive and frozen 75/25 naive/TimesFM on identical windows.
execution_contract.segment_definition: November/December target dates versus all other target dates, consistent with existing holiday/rest summaries.
execution_contract.decision_rule: Historical exploratory screen only. Advance to fresh confirmation when the fixed blend improves mean WAPE against both comparators without a larger worst-window loss than the frozen TimesFM blend; report signed bias and runtime separately. No production change.
